What are Foreign Transaction Fees?

Foreign transaction fees are charges that are added to your credit card bill when you make a purchase in a foreign currency. These fees can range from 1-3% of the total purchase amount and can add up quickly. By choosing a credit card with no foreign transaction fees, you can avoid these extra charges and keep more of your money in your pocket.

personal_stories.title: How to Build an Emergency Fund as a High School Student
personal_stories.summary: Building an emergency fund is an essential part of personal finance, but it can be challenging to know where to start. As a high school student, you may not have a lot of money to spare, but there are still ways to build an emergency fund and protect yourself from unexpected expenses. By starting small and being consistent, you can build a safety net that will serve you well for years to come.
personal_stories.fullContent:
Building an emergency fund is an essential part of personal finance, but it can be challenging to know where to start. As a high school student, you may not have a lot of money to spare, but there are still ways to build an emergency fund and protect yourself from unexpected expenses. The first step is to determine how much you need to save. A good rule of thumb is to aim to save 3-6 months' worth of living expenses in an easily accessible savings account.

What is an Emergency Fund?

An emergency fund is a savings account that is set aside to cover unexpected expenses, such as car repairs or medical bills. By having an emergency fund in place, you can avoid going into debt when unexpected expenses arise and ensure that you have a safety net to fall back on.

Aim to save 3-6 months' worth of living expenses in an easily accessible savings account.

Action Step

Start by setting aside a small amount each month, such as $10 or $20, and gradually increase the amount over time. You can also consider setting up automatic transfers from your checking account to your savings account to make saving easier and less prone to being neglected.
